## Introduction

This file will explore the distribution of categories in the raw data through histograms to determine statistical tests to run on them after some data cleaning in a base R script.


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# R Setup & housekeeping
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	include = TRUE,
	message = FALSE,
	warning = FALSE)

rm(list=ls())
objects()
```

```{r}
# Packages
library("gert")
library("usethis")
library("here")
library("tidyverse")
library("readxl")
```

```{r}
# Import Raw Data sheet
raw_data <- read_excel(here::here("Data/SELTMP-2025-GBR-surveydataset_v1-0_RecFishingCLUSTERS_RyanW-Sept-22-2026.xlsx"), sheet = "Raw_Data")

raw_data
```
